findings.title: Sequential interaction arithmetic erased nonzero BF16 interaction
findings.cause: Left-associated0-1-2^-60+1 discards the small BF16 term before cancellation; fsum of squares afterward cannot recover it. This does not show the real model has this pattern.
findings.root_fix: math.fsum((w,-y,-z,x)) per element and full72-output cancellation regression test.

review_basis.controls: Complete original bytes hash-bound to trusted case expected_attention; original==previous_own==previous_restore==current own==current restore; previous_both==current b4_strided. All finite full bytes. Both rank official target bytes identical.
review_basis.metrics: Exact BF16 decoding; FP64 full-row L2/max_abs; aggregate norm uses summed squared errors and summed reference energies, not mean relative errors. Four pairing directions and RHS denominators match definition. Official interaction normalization uses official target norm. Signed zero raw difference distinct from numeric difference; zero norm explicitly None. No acceptance thresholds or causal percentage claims introduced.
review_basis.provenance_boundary: Module explicitly takes authenticated cases/controls.
